comment: เสียงบรรยาย 'The YouTuber Who Walked Away From 20 MILLION Subscribers' — ทั้ง 18 ช็อตเป็น TTS ล้วน (ไม่มีเสียงจริง)

segments.text: This man walked away from 20 MILLION subscribers.
But weekends? Alaska — with his three sons.
Thieves re-uploaded his videos — 4 BILLION views.
And fame was closing in on his kids.
So in May 2025, he posted one video. "Goodbye."
At his absolute peak. On purpose.
Fans were heartbroken. Millions begged him to stay.
Three final videos. 7.5 million views in days.
So… is he back for good?
His answer: just doing exactly what I told you.
And his channel? Still growing. 20 million strong — without him.
Hero… or crazy? Could YOU walk away? Comment below.
